Title: Smooth trainer hiring and onboarding - All SLA targets met
Note: Edge case: Exceptionally fast hiring (16 days vs 30 target) with excellent performance metrics

Title: Trainer hiring delayed - Slow assessment process
RootCause: External assessment vendor delay - high volume
Note: Edge case: Assessment delayed 1 day past SLA but within acceptable bounds (6 vs 5 days)

Title: Trainer onboarding extends beyond 14-day SLA
RootCause: Platform training vendor delayed session scheduling
Note: Edge case: 3-day delay in onboarding (17 vs 14 days) but within acceptable variance

Title: Trainer certification expires within 3 months
CorrectiveAction: Scheduled recertification training for May, created backup trainer plan
Note: Edge case: Trainer certified but expiry within 3 months - requires early recertification planning

Title: Learner satisfaction drops to 5.5/10 after first week
RootCause: Trainer pacing too fast, unclear explanations, limited interaction
CorrectiveAction: Performance improvement plan initiated, paired with senior trainer mentor
Note: Edge case: Critical drop in learner satisfaction (5.5 vs 8.0 target) triggers intervention

Title: Trainer achieves perfect satisfaction score (10/10)
Note: Edge case: Perfect satisfaction score (10/10) demonstrates exceptional trainer performance

Title: Trainer misses scheduled session - No-show incident
CorrectiveAction: Backup trainer deployed, incident documented, medical condition verified
Note: Edge case: Critical no-show due to emergency but quickly resolved with backup trainer

Title: Training material quality issue - Content non-compliance
RootCause: Trainer used outdated curriculum version, failed to review before session
CorrectiveAction: Updated materials, curriculum review training provided
Note: Edge case: Material quality significantly below target (6.5 vs 8.5) requiring remediation

Title: Trainer performance gradually declines over 4 weeks
RootCause: Trainer fatigue, increased course load without preparation time
CorrectiveAction: Adjusted schedule, added prep time between sessions, mentoring support
Note: Edge case: Gradual performance decline pattern detected and addressed before critical breach

Title: Trainer requests schedule modification mid-month
RootCause: Trainer personal scheduling conflict, childcare needs
CorrectiveAction: Approved modified schedule starting next month, reassigned courses accordingly
Note: Edge case: Mid-month schedule change requires coordination but within SLA response time

Title: Last-minute trainer replacement due to medical emergency
RootCause: Original trainer hospitalized - acute medical condition
CorrectiveAction: Incident documented, medical leave approved, backup trainer thanked
Note: Edge case: Critical emergency with 4-hour notice but successfully managed with backup trainer

Title: Training delays due to platform technical issues
RootCause: Platform vendor infrastructure issue - power outage at data center
Note: Edge case: Technical platform outage (SLA exclusion) with quick resolution

Title: Hiring timeline significantly exceeded - 45 days to hire
RootCause: Extended offer negotiation, candidate requests for schedule flexibility
Note: Edge case: 45-day hiring (exceeds 30-day target by 15 days) - 15% signing bonus reduction applied

Title: Multiple trainers assigned to same course - Coordination issues
RootCause: Lack of coordination between trainers, insufficient handoff documentation
CorrectiveAction: Implemented joint planning sessions, unified curriculum version, daily sync meetings
Note: Edge case: Multiple trainers on same course require tight coordination and consistent standards

Title: Trainer exceptional first month - All metrics exceed targets
Note: Edge case: Exceptional performance across all metrics (15%+ above targets) in first month
